name: Henrietta von Willleben
original_name: ヘンリエッタ・フォン・ヴィルレーベン
source:
Race: Vamp

The eldest daughter of the Willleben family, a distinguished family which has produced high-ranking officials for generations. Like a typical [i]ojousama[/i], she is narcissistic and selfish. She is also an elitist, believing that the Vamp is the most superior race.
